question: What work was published by John Dalton in 1808 that provided a physical picture of how elements combine to form compounds and an unprecedented reason to believe that atoms exist?

options.text: Introduction to the Study of Chemical Philosophy
A New System of Chemical Philosophy
From Chemical Philosophy to Theoretical Chemistry

solution:
The correct answer is** __A New System of Chemical Philosophy__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• In 1808, John Dalton publish a paper titled 'A New System of Chemical Philosophy' describing principles such as the uniqueness of atoms of the same element, relative atomic mass and the laws of chemical combination.
 
• John Dalton raised the atomic theory that acted as an explanation of the following two laws.
